title: Sealed Blind Predictions for Growth-Rate Observables: Energy-Flow Cosmology vs ΛCDM
description: This paper presents pre-registered, cryptographically sealed predictions from Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) for the large-scale structure growth observable fσ8(z) and the Hubble distance ratio DH/rd(z) at z = 0.7 and z = 1.0, prior to DESI DR2 full-shape RSD unblinding. Two independent NUTS-MCMC freezes predict suppressed growth relative to ΛCDM (e.g., fσ8(0.7)=0.430 vs 0.449), providing falsifiable, multi-observable tests once DR2 is released.

key_results.main_finding: Sealed EFC predictions indicate suppressed late-time growth relative to ΛCDM, with fσ8(0.7)=0.430 vs 0.449 (2.0σ), and DH/rd lower than ΛCDM at z=0.7 and z=1.0 (2.3–3.1σ separations), to be tested by DESI DR2 full-shape RSD/BAO.

sealed_predictions.statement: Primary freeze (2026-02-18; α = −0.689) predicts fσ8(z=0.7) = 0.430, compared to ΛCDM’s 0.449 (2.0σ separation).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DESI DR2 full-shape RSD measurement of fσ8 at z≈0.7 (LRG/ELG), with quoted statistical/systematic errors.

sealed_predictions.statement: Primary freeze predicts DH/rd(z=0.7) = 19.797, below ΛCDM’s 20.719 (≈2.3σ separation).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DESI DR2 BAO/full-shape distance constraints at z≈0.7.

sealed_predictions.statement: Primary freeze predicts DH/rd(z=1.0) = 16.527, below ΛCDM’s 17.466 (≈3.1σ separation).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DESI DR2 BAO/full-shape distance constraints at z≈1.0.

sealed_predictions.statement: Both sealed freezes yield α < 0 (−0.689 and −0.702), implying suppressed growth at z ≲ 1 relative to ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint DESI DR2 growth/BAO likelihood showing α ≥ 0 (or consistent with 0) at high confidence.

sealed_predictions.statement: Primary freeze reports an fσ8 crossover redshift at z ≈ 2.042.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Combined high-z growth measurements (e.g., DESI QSO/LYA-era constraints) mapping fσ8(z) behavior above z≈1.5.

kill_criteria: KC1: DESI DR2 full-shape fσ8 at z≈0.7 is consistent with ΛCDM’s 0.449 within 1σ and inconsistent with EFC’s 0.430 at ≥2σ across independent tracers (LRG/ELG).
KC2: DESI DR2 DH/rd at z=0.7 and/or z=1.0 is consistent with ΛCDM expectations within 1σ and inconsistent with EFC predictions at ≥2σ, removing the predicted downward trend versus ΛCDM.
KC3: Joint DR2 analysis returns a posterior for the EFC coupling α centered at or above 0 such that α < 0 is disfavored at ≥95% confidence.

KC4: Cross-tracer inconsistency: if only a single tracer marginally supports EFC while the combined multi-tracer DR2 dataset rejects EFC predictions at ≥2σ, the EFC growth-suppression mechanism is disfavored.
KC5: Cryptographic verification fails (sealed MCMC chain hashes or timestamps do not match the published SHA-256 values), invalidating the pre-registration claim.
